title: Lyceum Student
subtitle: First Questions of the Lyceum
bodyText: A Lyceum student records questions, studies arguments, and checks simple observations with the school. Careful notes and a willingness to test an explanation begin the habits that later support independent research and teaching.
sceneBrief: An adult student records questions and simple observations while learning in the Lyceum; introductory inquiry rather than general courier work.
